why: `actor/sergeant` is `vulnerable`: its puppet takes blows and can die. An answer box on it would take every blow meant for the fight, so a line there can never be shown. The validation names the line and why. It declares no unit: `answers.struck` is bound by the primary on `actor/hall-sentry` and `npc/copyist`; what the engine refuses is a line on a body that can be harmed.
